parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: Schema
parameters.description: The name of the schema to which the table belongs.

parameters.name: SecretArn
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the access credential for the created Data API account. You can call the CreateSecret operation to create an access credential.

>  To call the DescribeTable operation as a Resource Access Management (RAM) user, the RAM user must have the permissions to call the UseSecret or GetSecretValue operation on the ARN of the access credential.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-table --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --workspace-id gp-ws-00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --secret-arn acs:gpdb:cn-beijing:103300:secret/testsecret-eG2AQGRIwQ0zFp4VA7mYL3uiCXTfDQbQ --database adbtest --schema public --table mytable --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb DescribeTable --region cn-hangzhou --SecretArn 'acs:gpdb:cn-beijing:103300:secret/testsecret-eG2AQGRIwQ0zFp4VA7mYL3uiCXTfDQbQ' --Table mytable --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --Schema public --WorkspaceId 'gp-ws-00000' --Database adbtest --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
